acceptance_condition.finite_remainder_requirement: After the universal raw inequality is proved, all covered even targets below N0 must be verified by an independent finite remainder check.
acceptance_condition.required_universal_statement: There exist an explicit threshold N0 and an explicit covered even-target class such that, for every covered even N>=N0, A_raw_-(N) < L_raw(N).

candidate.falsifier: Any covered target with A_raw_-(N)>=L_raw(N) falsifies this sufficient route for the current coefficient.
candidate.mechanism: Bound the one-sided raw projected binary-prime drag below the raw local main term at each target, without first normalizing by existing strict-central mass.
candidate.name: raw pointwise q286-WBSS adverse-drag estimate
candidate.prediction: A valid theorem will explain why the summed adverse raw projections cannot erase the q286-WBSS raw local main term.
candidate.smallest_next_theorem_target: Prove A_raw_-(N)<L_raw(N) for all sufficiently large covered even N, then verify the finite remainder.

decision: The q286-WBSS route now has a non-circular raw sufficient inequality target: A_raw_-(N)<L_raw(N).  The checked rows satisfy it, but this is finite calibration only.  A Goldbach-yielding bridge still needs a universal pointwise raw adverse-drag theorem or another direct raw witness lower bound.

definitions.raw_local_main: L_raw(N)=T_N*M(N), where M(N)=<u_a,phi_a> is the local q286-WBSS main term for a=N mod 10010.
definitions.raw_projected_error: U_d(N)=T_N*E_d(N), equivalently the raw projected binary-prime discrepancy against the d-th WBSS projection.
definitions.strict_central_total_weight: T_N=sum log(p)log(N-p) over strict-central prime pairs N/3<p<2N/3.
definitions.sufficient_pointwise_inequality: A_raw_-(N)<L_raw(N) implies L_raw(N)+sum_d U_d(N)>0, hence W_phi(N)>0.
definitions.zero_support_boundary: If strict-central support is empty, then T_N=0, L_raw(N)=0, U_d(N)=0, and A_raw_-(N)=0; the strict inequality cannot hold.  Therefore a proved strict raw adverse-drag inequality forces support.

status_boundary: q286-WBSS raw adverse-drag theorem target only; finite rows are calibration and falsifier evidence, not acceptance.  No raw adverse-drag theorem, raw witness theorem, positive-mass theorem, q286 threshold theorem, strict-central Goldbach theorem, or Goldbach proof
